newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal eases in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal eases in liquid market.

text.p: Higher liquidity in the Saudi market saw the spot Saudi riyal ease slightly against the U.S. dollar in quiet trade this week but riyal interbank deposit rates were unchanged, dealers in Saudi Arabia said on Wednesday.

"The spot riyal eased. The market is very liquid," one Riyadh-based dealer said, adding there were no changes in riyal deposit rates. The spot riyal was at 3.7503/05 to the dollar from 3.7502/04 last week.
One-month interbank rates were put at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, three months 5-5/8, 1/2 percent, six months 5-3/4, 5/8 percent and one-year funds were at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent.
